desc: Establish the structural reduction: type-2 ops leave exactly the intersection interval to cover; min cost ∈ {1,2,3} or -1, and cost 2 is exactly one of {two type-1 with union [1,N], type-1 containing type-2, two disjoint type-2}.
Implement the corrected O(M log M) algorithm: cost1; containment first; then union-of-two-op1; then two-disjoint-op2; then cost3 construction for M>=3; else -1.

Brute-force checker: exhaustively verified for small N,M that reported K equals the true minimum and the printed assignment achieves all x_j=1; cross-checked against the implementation with no counterexamples found.
